name: Teach Braille
pitch: Free braille practice games and lessons, plus Delaney Costello's TVI services and courses, at teachbraille.org and in the iPhone and iPad app.
deployCommand: git push origin master (Vercel builds master only; the build runs the full test suite)

apple.state: 1.1 approved 2026-11-17; 1.1.1 PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION, submit waits on Jackson

audience.analyticsSource: Umami, studio tracker at a.unpossible.studio (plus Vercel Analytics)
audience.searchConsole: verified by meta tag in app/layout.tsx

rules: Never run db:push against production (archive tables not in schema.prisma); apply generated SQL only.
All braille comes from lib/braille/; oracle, geometry and axe checks before every merge.
The apex https://teachbraille.org is canonical; www redirects to it.
GitHub Actions is manual only; run checks on the VPS through heavy.
No em dashes in user-facing copy; no decorative graphics.
